newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises more than 50 points in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises more than 50 points in morning trade.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 50 points Friday, resuming the previous session's strong gain on another economic report that showed inflation under control last month.

At 9:55 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue chip issues was up 50.21 points at 7,761.68, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. The Nasdaq index gained 2.62 to 1,413.94. The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was up 15/32, sending its yield down to 6.74 percent after the government reported that producer prices fell for the fifth straight month in May, dropping by 0.3 percent.
